gen-dafont-bloody-gf-geist: Geist keeps a quiet, level beat, its words settling into solid blocks with no accents of weight. And Bloody's big round bowls up top give that plain sans something to push against, loud above and hushed below.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-georama: Georama reads approachable, its wide-open c like a bracelet pulled apart. Under Bloody's commanding heading, a long stretch of this sans-serif would feel unhurried, with barely rising capitals keeping the lines low and friendly.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-gidole: Clean and measured, Gidole draws every stroke like neon tube, its terminals staying apart like open scissor blades. Gidole is the one to size up or down as needed, since Bloody's heavy bowls already carry the top of the page.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-golos-text: Loud meets level here, with Bloody's big round bowls above a body whose x-height fills the line. And Golos Text, cut to one stroke width throughout, keeps its widely parted s open and steady beneath that heavy heading.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Bloody brings dark, bowl-heavy drama, while Hedvig Letters Sans stays approachable underneath. And its small letters, standing almost as tall as capitals, leave a clear gap where the c ends, which softens that commanding heading.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-heebo: Heebo reads with a tall central band of text, its curves stopping short instead of closing in. Heebo and Bloody make the pair's strongest quality their opposition: a commanding display face over a quiet sans-serif.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-hind-guntur: Bloody's big round lowercase bowls are the first thing you notice, heavy and unmistakably commanding. Hind Guntur answers with a cable-like stroke and no thick-thin shift, making the pair's strongest quality its stamped-metal plainness against all that swagger.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-hind-madurai: Approachable Hind Madurai fills the line with lowercase forms like capitals, its s curves opening wide at both ends. Bloody makes the loud entrance; this sans keeps going without hairlines to squint at.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-hind-mysuru: Hind Mysuru presses its lowercase close to ascender height. Bloody does the shouting with big round bowls, while this sans-serif holds up in small sizes, with no calligraphic thinning and each a left ajar.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-hind-siliguri: Bloody's big round lowercase bowls give it a bold, bloody presence. Hind Siliguri hums in flat gray, its plain sans body sized freely without worry.
